mappings.note: The translation verse contains text about Ephraim lying and Israel deceiving while Judah ruled with God. This entire opening clause is absent from OSMAIN v1, which starts directly with 'Efraim gjeter vind...'. The content of this verse appears to be a combination of Hosea 12:1 (first half) and the beginning of Hosea 12:2 in some traditions, but it does not map to any single OSMAIN verse.

Translation v2 covers the content of OSMAIN v1 ('Efraim gjeter vind...') but omits the opening clause found in Translation v1. It matches the second half of the thought process usually associated with Hosea 12:1-2.
Matches OSMAIN v2 perfectly in content (Lords case against Judah, punishing Jacob).
Translation v4 covers the first half of OSMAIN v3 ('I mors liv grep han sin bror...') but stops before the second clause about manhood strength.

Translation v5 combines the second half of OSMAIN v3 ('...og i sin manndomskraft kjempet han med Gud') with all of OSMAIN v4 ('Han kjempet med engelen...'). The translation splits the single OSMAIN verse 3 into two parts (v4 and v5) and merges the second part with OSMAIN v4.
Matches OSMAIN v6 ('Så vend om til din Gud!...').
Matches OSMAIN v7 ('En kjøpmann er han...').
Matches OSMAIN v8 ('Efraim sier: «Jeg er blitt rik...»).'
Matches OSMAIN v9 ('Men jeg er Herren din Gud fra landet Egypt...').
Matches OSMAIN v10 ('Jeg har talt til profetene...').
Matches OSMAIN v11 ('Om Gilead er ondskap...').
Matches OSMAIN v12 ('Jakob flyktet til Arams sletter...').
Matches OSMAIN v13 ('Ved en profet førte Herren Israel opp fra Egypt...').
Matches OSMAIN v14 ('Efraim har vakt bitter vrede...').

extraContent.description: The entire verse 'Ephraïm m'a abordé avec des mensonges, et la maison d'Israël avec des tromperies, lorsque Juda dominait encore avec le [Dieu] Fort, et [qu'il était] fidèle avec les Saints.' is not present in the OSMAIN text. OSMAIN v1 begins directly with 'Efraim gjeter vind...'. This suggests the translation includes a verse (Hosea 12:1) that is either missing from this specific OSMAIN manuscript or has been merged into the start of v1 in other traditions, but here it stands as an extra verse.
